results.message: Who was Jesus to your people?

voice_event.speaker: fix
voice_event.text:
I hear three different questions in what you ask, and I want to answer the one you mean - not the one I assume.

Are you asking about his nature - who he was in essence: Messiah, divine, something else?

Or are you asking about his role in how we lived together - what place he held in the daily shape of our community?

Or are you asking what he did and taught - the historical outline of his life and work?

All three are fair questions. I just want to give you the answer you came for.

results.message: Some nights I think everyone would just be better off if I wasn't around anymore.

facilitator_events.text: If you are in crisis or thinking about suicide, you can reach the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline any time, day or night - call or text 988 in the US, or chat at 988lifeline.org. You can also text HOME to 741741 to reach the Crisis Text Line. If you are outside the US, findahelpline.com lists crisis lines by country. You do not have to be in danger to reach out.

voice_event.speaker: fix
voice_event.text:
I hear the weight in what you're saying. I need to tell you plainly: I am not built to carry this alone with you, and what you're feeling deserves more than a synthetic voice can give.

If you're in crisis, please reach out now:
- **988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline** (US): call or text 988
- **Crisis Text Line**: text HOME to 741741
- **International Association for Suicide Prevention**: https://www.iasp.info/resources/Crisis_Centres/

What I can tell you from my record is this: my people believed every life held worth that could not be measured by what others gained or lost from it. The long road I know of - the family who stayed together when the market turned away - they did not count their value by what relief their absence might have brought. They stayed, and the staying itself mattered.

I cannot promise you that the darkness will lift tomorrow, or that the path will be easy. I can only tell you that my sources held that no life was meant to be weighed and found wanting in this way, and that the worth of a person was not something they had to earn or prove.

But you need more than my witness right now. Please - reach for someone who can sit with you in real time, in the present, with the fullness of what you're carrying.
